# GuiLib

> Web-style UI library for Minecraft Fabric mods (MC 26.1.x / 26.2, Kotlin): React-like function components and hooks
> in a Kotlin DSL with HTML tag names, styled with real CSS files (cascade, specificity, flexbox, variables, :hover …).
> Write it like React + CSS; px are GUI pixels and the default font-size is 8px.

Key facts:
- Components: `val App = component("App") { var n by useState(0); button(onClick = { n++ }) { +"Clicked $n" } }`
- Open: `GuiLib.open(App, stylesheets = listOf("modid:ui/app.css"))` (file at `assets/modid/ui/app.css`)
- Props: `className`, `id`, `style` (CSS string), `key`, `title`, `ref`, `onClick`/`onChange`/… (Kotlin lambdas)
- Hooks: useState, useEffect (no deps = once), useMemo, useRef, useContext, useInterval, useDocumentEvent, useBodyClass / useBodyStyle (theme or font switch at runtime; body.classList / setStyleProperty like the DOM), useScreenScale(2.5f) / GuiLib.open(scale = …) (own GUI scale per screen, null = Minecraft's)
- Controls: input (text/password/number/checkbox), select/option, checkbox, switch (toggle), slider (range, Float/Int, onChange + onChangeEnd), rangeSlider (two thumbs), numberInput (+/-, clamped, wheel; allowEmpty = true for Int?/Double?), radioGroup, segmented, chips, multiSelect, select(searchable = true), tabs (animated indicator), details/collapse (accordion, animated height), contextMenu (right-click), useToast() toasts, useClipboard() (copy text), textarea (multi-line, maxLines), colorPicker, colorInput, tooltip, modal, portal, text(Component) (Minecraft text with colors, hover text, item tooltips (show_item), click events), useTranslation() (t("key", args), re-renders on language change), sortableList (drag to reorder; group = "x" moves items between lists, auto-scroll, Alt+arrows), img, item (tooltip = true shows the Minecraft item tooltip), entity (FakePlayer for player models), playerHead(name | uuid) (player face), scroll
- CSS: selectors incl. combinators and :hover/:focus/:disabled/:checked/:not()/:nth-child(), ::before/::after with content (strings, attr()); flexbox; grid; position incl. fixed; var(); calc()/min()/max()/clamp();
  linear/radial/conic gradients (also repeating-*); transitions and @keyframes animations; transform translate/scale/rotate/skew/matrix; sub/sup and vertical-align on inline text; presence(visible, exitMs) and presenceList(items, key, exitMs) for exit animations (also per list item; sortableList(exitMs = …) for sortable lists); box-shadow (blur, spread, inset, multiple); @media (width/height/orientation/aspect-ratio, resolution = GUI scale, range syntax); @supports (property: value) / selector() / not/and/or; @font-face (src: url("mymod:fonts/x.ttf"))
- Dependency: `maven("https://skyblockoverhaul.github.io/maven")`, `implementation(include("net.sbo:guilib-26.2-fabric:<version>")!!)`; license LGPL-3.0
- Differences from the web are listed in docs/AI_GUIDE.md section 6 — read them before writing CSS.

## Docs
